title: Radon Spike After Basement Vent Changes
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radon:reading
| search vent_change_window=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(radon_bq_m3) as avg_radon_bq_m3 by _time vent_change_window
| sort - _time
description: Tracks radon after basement vent changes over time and breaks it out by vent-change flag.
value: Post-change spikes show whether the ventilation adjustment helped, hurt, or simply changed the daily pattern.
implementation: Send radon after basement vent changes events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of radon after basement vent changes by vent-change flag.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how radon after basement vent changes changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
